description: Set the length of zones on the segments. If the specified zone length causes the number of zones on the segment to exceed the limits (1-10000), the limit value is used for the segment.
notes: Not available in 7.0: Not listed in the official FLAC3D 7.0 contents command index. (https://docs.itascacg.com/flac3d700/contents.html)
The 2D sketch 'segment'/'segment-node' objects are new in the 9.x sketch workflow; in 7.0 the equivalent 2D geometry is built with 'extrude point' and 'extrude edge' commands.
